context: Asuka lectures on population and cities.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: demography lecture; population vocabulary (人口/平均/中央/増加) seeded in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 都市の人口は、年々増加しています。
lines.en: Urban populations increase year by year.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 人口は、中央に集まるんですか?
lines.en: Does the population gather in the center?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、中央の都市に集中しがちです。
lines.en: Yes, it tends to concentrate in central cities.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 平均すると、どのくらい増加していますか?
lines.en: On average, how much is it increasing?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 平均で、毎年少しずつ増加しています。
lines.en: On average, it rises a little each year.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 地方の人口は、どうなりますか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地方では、人口が減る傾向です。
lines.en: In rural areas, the population tends to fall.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 都市の増加は、課題も生みますね。
lines.style: understanding adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
